integrity: Sharp constant and the complete equality family have an algebraic proof and independently formulated numerical and exact-symbolic replay tests. No externally independent mathematical audit, validation or publication acceptance is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact constant is proved only under fifteen-character pair-sum nonaliasing, including standard two-dimensional tori and finite products of cyclic orders at least five and three. No statements concern aliased orders, all five-point support classes, or higher moments. An equivalence to older two-dimensional sparse-polynomial/autocorrelation literature is a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp fourth moments for a five-point Ferrers Fourier spectrum
